description: This file implements binary search tree operations including search, insertion, in-order traversal, and memory cleanup for tree nodes.

methods.name: struct:tree_node * tree_search(struct tree_node * tree,void * key,int (* compare)(const void *,const void *))
methods.description: Recursively searches the binary search tree for a node with a matching key using a comparison callback.

methods.name: struct:tree_node * tree_insert(struct tree_node ** rootp,void * key,int (* compare)(const void *,const void *))
methods.description: Recursively inserts a new node into the binary search tree while maintaining the tree properties.

methods.name: void infix_walk(struct tree_node * t,void (* action)(void * arg,void * key),void * arg)
methods.description: Performs an in-order traversal of the tree, applying a provided action to each node's key.

methods.name: void tree_free(struct tree_node * t)
methods.description: Recursively frees memory allocated for the tree nodes.
